name: subagent
label: Subagent
description: Delegate tasks to other installed agents with isolated context.

agent.description: Name of the installed agent to invoke (single mode).

cwd.description: Working directory for the subagent process (single mode).

tasks.description: Array of {agent, task, cwd?} for parallel mode.

chain.description: Array of {agent, task, cwd?} for chain mode; use {previous} placeholder.

agent_scope.description: Which agent directories to search. 'user' uses ~/.nova/agent/agents, 'project' uses <cwd>/.nova/agent/agents, 'both' merges them.

prompt_snippet: Use the `subagent` tool to delegate specialized tasks to other installed agents. Modes: single { agent, task }, parallel { tasks: [...] }, chain { chain: [...] } — previous step output is available via {previous} placeholder.
